title: Silly Swap Words
engine: custom DOM runtime with shared QLOBE interaction, audio, screen, timer, celebration, and debug modules
shareTitle: Silly Swap Words — Tap One Sound, Meet a New Word
description: A handcrafted clay word workshop where children tap one letter to transform CAT into HAT, follow sound-changing word trails, and invent delightfully silly CVC words.
learningGoals: Hear how changing one phoneme creates a different word
Blend and segment short consonant-vowel-consonant words
Explore real and invented words with curiosity and no penalty
interactionModel: tap one of three large clay letter wells, or use Magic Swap, to change exactly one sound and immediately reveal the new word picture
feedbackModel: Every swap speaks the changed sound and resulting word; real words transform into clay objects, invented words meet a friendly lab creature, and misses receive a gentle spoken hint with no loss state.

modes.title: Guided Swaps
modes.skill: guided phoneme substitution with useful intermediate words

modes.title: Word Trails
modes.skill: sequential one-sound changes across a connected CVC chain

modes.title: Silly Word Lab
modes.skill: open CVC construction and playful real/nonsense-word exploration
